items.title: PM admits One Nation's rise influenced decision to overhaul tax system
items.description: The rise of One Nation is partly behind the government's decision to take on tax reform in this year's budget, the prime minister has admitted.

items.title: Flu numbers are down for now – this could be why
items.description: Flu cases have come down since the record-breaking 2025 season but experts warn against a "false sense of security".

items.title: Andrew made money subletting cottages on his almost rent-free estate, watchdog finds
items.description: Former prince Andrew pocketed income from cottages on the Windsor estate while living at Royal Lodge under a lease that required virtually no rent, a watchdog report has found.

items.title: Drone blast in Romania prompts fresh warning over Ukraine war spillover
items.description: A Ukrainian naval drone has exploded in Romania's Black Sea port of Constanta, as European leaders warned the war in Ukraine is becoming a "direct threat" to countries along the EU's eastern border.

items.title: Sydney police officer sentenced over death of Indigenous 16yo
items.description: A NSW Police officer convicted over a fatal collision that killed an Indigenous teenager has avoided time behind bars.

items.title: ASIC names two KPMG partners it is formally investigating over audit scandal
items.description: ASIC tells a Senate estimates committee it is formally investigating KPMG and that it still has eight current contracts with the firm.

items.title: Bulldogs erase 29-point deficit to claim spiteful thriller against Hawks
items.description: The Western Bulldogs kick eight goals to one in the second half to overrun Hawthorn in a thriller at the MCG.

items.title: Shattered Storm superstar to miss entire NRL season
items.description: Melbourne will be without Queensland Origin player Xavier Coates for the rest of the NRL season after the winger ruptured his Achilles at training on Friday.

items.title: Mongols bikie escapes custody after scaling court dock, dashing past security
items.description: A manhunt is under way in Darwin as police search for Brandt Graham, a 44-year-old Mongols bikie who scaled an enclosed courthouse dock and escaped from custody today.

items.title: Rare Xi trip to North Korea highlights warming ties with Kim regime
items.description: Kim Jong Un has been trying to improve ties with China, North Korea's biggest trading partner and provider of aid.

items.title: Woman stabbed by ex says warning signs 'should have been enough'
items.description: A judge said Anthony Monteleone was "utterly delusional" in repeated messages to the woman before attacking her outside a Sydney gym in 2024.

items.title: Apprentice tradies aren't included in the minimum wage bump
items.description: Apprentice tradies aren't included in the new minimum wage bump. New tradies sit under a different awards system, where an electrical apprentice can earn as little as $15.67 an hour if they've just left school early. So, how does this impact the apprenticeship scheme, which is sold on the idea of being paid while you learn?

items.title: 'Like opening an oven': NT constable praised for 'heroic' rescue attempt
items.description: A "heroic" Alice Springs police officer who risked his life repeatedly entering a burning building in trying to rescue a three-year-old boy will be awarded a medal of valour.

items.title: Mary Fowler has crossed the threshold from athlete to cultural icon
items.description: Matildas star Mary Fowler is using her platform to share what matters to her, as she navigates becoming a truly global footballing superstar.

items.title: Need a mood boost? Here's why gardening might be worth a try
items.description: While gardening alone is not a treatment for mental illness, a growing body of evidence links it with higher levels of mental wellbeing and life satisfaction.

items.title: Princess Catherine hugs young mum ringing 'end of cancer treatment' bell
items.description: The Princess of Wales joined in a hospital cancer ward celebration for a young mum who completed chemotherapy.

items.title: Looking for another show like Off Campus? Right this way
items.description: Hannah and Garrett's steamy love story might be on ice, but we've found more romance and yearning to tick your comfort-viewing boxes.

items.title: ABC news quiz: Mystery markings, a premature celebration and a fight over the Big… something
items.description: You too could learn the dangers of celebrating too soon if you underestimate this week's news quiz.

items.title: No place like home with rescuers for Dorothy the kitten who survived the unthinkable
items.description: A kitten left for dead after being thrown from a moving car has spent months recovering and is now at a new home with two familiar faces.

items.title: Sunscreens that failed to meet SPF claims still under investigation
items.description: Most of the sunscreens that failed to meet their SPF label claims, according to independent testing, are still under investigation by the regulator one year later.

items.title: Emissions drop again, fuelling hopes Australia's hit a tipping point
items.description: Emissions are at their lowest point since the COVID pandemic shut down the economy, dropping 2.1 per cent over the year to December 2025.

items.title: Council CEO sent anonymous email to media alleging 'systemic corruption'
items.description: The head of a Western Sydney council sent an anonymous email to reporters alleging "systemic corruption" by a senior staff member was being "swept under the rug".

items.title: Biggest universal magnetic map unlocks new chapter of space research
items.description: Data gathered by scientists at the Square Kilometre Array has resulted in a new "map" detailing the magnetic web of our observable universe.

items.title: Visitors are up, but Mona remains reliant on gambling funds
items.description: Newly filed accounts give a first glimpse of Mona's ultimate holding company, showing the loss-making gallery remains heavily reliant on gambling funds.

items.title: Body-in-suitcase killer loses bid to reduce sentence for double murder
items.description: The NSW Court of Criminal Appeal dismisses a bid by Daniel Holdom to have his sentence reduced after he pleaded guilty in 2018 to murdering his girlfriend and her two-year-old daughter before dumping the child's body in a suitcase on the side of a remote highway.
